name: Bavarian infant feeding vessels
description: Small vessels from Bavarian child graves contain residues consistent with ruminant dairy products, supporting interpretation as infant feeding or weaning vessels.

impact.note: Vessels from one region's graves witness infant feeding with animal milk, a modest aid with no known later work resting on them.

date.label: Approximately 1200–450 BCE, cemetery contexts
date.basis: Approximate archaeological context; calibrated BP values use 1950 as reference.

events.statement: Small vessels from Bavarian child graves contain residues consistent with ruminant dairy products, supporting interpretation as infant feeding or weaning vessels.

evidence.supports: Three small vessels from child graves in Bronze and Iron Age Bavaria yielded residues consistent with ruminant dairy.

events.caveats: The oldest sample is from a cremation and may contain contaminants; the evidence is not direct observation of feeding or population-wide practice.
